title: Apollo 4: Southern Landing
tagline: Follow in the wheel tracks of a south pole landing.

goal.text: Touch down near the pole and run experiments on the soil
goal.why: Studying the ground near the pole shows what its soil is made of

facts.text: Chandrayaan-3's rover ramped down from the lander on August 24, 2023, and India took a walk on the Moon.
On August 28, 2023, the LIBS instrument on the Chandrayaan-3 rover confirmed the presence of sulphur on the lunar surface through in-situ measurements.
The Chandrayaan-3 ChaSTE payload on the Vikram lander made the first temperature observations of the lunar soil, reported August 27, 2023.

candidate_sites.name: Shackleton Rim
candidate_sites.why: Good sunlight and a long view of Earth

candidate_sites.name: Connecting Ridge
candidate_sites.why: A ridge that keeps the lander above the dark

candidate_sites.name: de Gerlache Rim
candidate_sites.why: Gentle ground, a short walk from the pole

ship.rationale: A short, careful mission: enough battery to last through the shadows and instruments that read the soil.

cruise.story: Debris on radar. Steer through the gaps.
Lost the radio link. Re-align the antenna to reconnect.
A fuel line is leaking pressure. Reroute the pipes.

tasks.title: Walk to the test spot
tasks.hint: Follow the pale path away from the lander

tasks.title: Read the soil
tasks.hint: Hold the scanner over the dark patch

voice_lines.text: Apollo 4, Houston. Your job is a careful landing and a careful look at the ground. Take your time.
Apollo 4, all stations go for launch.
Apollo 4, steady and slow. Pick a gentle spot to land.
Apollo 4, the soil data is coming in. Great work, crew.
